demand_phase.ceo_summary: We will enhance our CI pipeline robustness by deploying a minimal, highly observable API service to ensure faster, more reliable smoke test verification.
constraints: • Implement a minimal HTTP echo server endpoint.
• Integrate structured logging (e.g., JSON format) for all verification events.
• Ensure the service is lightweight and has minimal overhead.
• Define clear API contracts for CI consumers.
• Ensure robust error handling within the server logic.
demand_phase.cpo_summary: The product shape will be a minimal API service focusing purely on echo functionality and structured logging to ensure rapid feasibility and low maintenance overhead.
demand_phase.rationale: An API service is the most suitable modality as it allows the creation of a lightweight, decoupled HTTP echo server that can be easily integrated into a CI pipeline for verification, fulfilling the requirement for a headless service.

stack_phase.build_notes: CMake for dependency management and build configuration; unit tests for server logic and logging integration; Dockerfile for containerized deployment.
stack_phase.cto_summary: We will deploy a highly efficient C++ service to provide rapid, observable smoke test verification within the CI pipeline.
risks: Over-engineering the minimal service; complexity in achieving high-throughput structured logging; integration friction with existing CI infrastructure.

user_brief: Headless CI verification brief extend repo smoke coverage with minimal HTTP echo server and structured logging
